_readme_1: UsbNetFix config. Every USB-tethering profile is named after the phone that created it.
_readme_2: Resolution order: DeviceRules -> name learned earlier for this device -> the model name the phone reports over USB -> DefaultName. 'Network N' can never happen.
_readme_3: DeviceRules fields: Vid (USB vendor id), ModelLike (regex on the model name the phone reports), SerialLike (regex on the USB serial number), Name (what to call it), Note.
_readme_4: SerialLike is the reliable discriminator when several phones are used: Windows reports the model name per USB serial number, not per port.
_readme_5: Category: Private (file sharing / discovery work) | Public | Keep
_readme_6: ForgetLegacyProfiles=true removes that phone's own leftover profiles from earlier sessions, so the list never grows.
_readme_7: IMPORTANT: give every phone a DIFFERENT Name - two phones sharing one name would look like leftovers of each other.
_readme_8: To find the serial of a phone: run 'UsbNetFix.cmd names' while it is plugged in, or look at state.json (DeviceId is VID:serial).
